['Gauselmann AG '].company_description: Gauselmann AG is a family-owned business group in the entertainment and leisure industry, known for developing, producing, and distributing entertainment gaming devices with and without the possibility of winning money, as well as money management systems. The company also operates a chain of gaming arcades and is involved in sports betting, online gaming, financial services, and casinos.

['B\u00e4ko-Zentrale eG '].company_description: Bäko-Zentrale eG operates in the artisan bakery sector and offers a range of products including dried fruit products such as sea buckthorn, acerola, and blueberry, as well as machinery and equipment for bakeries. The company also participates in industry events and provides cooperative solutions for the baking industry.
